title: Sora Workflow: How to Set One Up (2026 Guide)
summary: A Sora workflow follows five steps: write prompts, generate, review, revise and export.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


These are the questions the body leaves open. Each answer carries the date it was last verified, because every one of them can change without notice.


### Is Sora free to use in 2026?


Treat **free access as a trial, not a plan** . Availability and allowances have shifted more than once, so run one realistic prompt through the full loop before building a schedule around it.


If the free allowance runs out mid-project, you want to learn that during a test and not on deadline day. Checked 2026-11-16.


### Can I use Sora videos commercially?


Generally yes, but the terms that apply to your account decide it, not a blog post. Read OpenAI's current terms for your plan before publishing anything paid or client-facing.


Separately, the output can still contain a recognizable person or someone else's characters, and the license doesn't cover that. Keep a record of the prompt and the terms version you relied on. Checked 2026-11-16.


### Does Sora have an API I can build on?


Not reliably. **The API was scheduled to shut down on September 24, 2026, and that date has passed.** Check OpenAI's deprecation notices before you design anything around it.


A pipeline built on an endpoint that no longer exists fails silently in the worst place, usually the export step. Until you've confirmed a replacement, use the app interface as the only supported path in your workflow. Checked 2026-11-16.


### Why does Sora block my prompt?


Somewhere in the prompt, or in what the model was about to generate, a moderation filter matched something. Common triggers are real people's likenesses, protected characters, and violent or sexual content.


The refusal rarely names the offending phrase, so cut the prompt down, find the trigger by removing one element at a time, and rewrite that element. Resubmitting the same text unchanged just spends your allowance on the same refusal. Checked 2026-11-16.


### How long can a Sora video be?


Which ceiling applies depends on your plan and the model version, and both have changed. The duration control in the generation settings shows what your account allows today, so read it there instead of trusting a number quoted elsewhere.


If your idea needs more runtime than the control offers, plan it as separate shots and join them in the edit. Checked 2026-11-16.
